Mar 10, 2022 #1

We’ve moved the Interledger community calls to be once a month, on the second Wednesday of the month.

We’ll have 5 regular update slots, from the Interledger Foundation, Rafiki, Fynbos, Coil and Open Payments teams, with additional slots open for anyone that would like to share their project or a discussion item for the broader community.

The next community call will be on 2022-04-13T15:00:00Z → 2022-04-13T16:00:00Z

Please post topics you’d like to discuss here and some background context for the rest of the community.

Apr 14, 2022 #5

Meeting Minutes:

  • Coil Updates:

    • Focus on Rafiki, Open Payments Spec.
    • Adding Nathan to the Rafiki team.

  • Rafiki Updates:

    • In the process of adding Open Payments V.2 endpoints to Rafiki
    • List Endpoints work in progress
    • Spec updated last week
    • Quoting has been extracted as an extra step and is not included in the creation of outgoing payments anymore
    • Spec’d out the auth server for Rafiki
    • Open Payments will use GNAP for authorization
    • Nathan is now on the Rafiki team
    • Milestones, issues, and weekly calls are now open to the community. github.com/interledger/rafiki/milestones 1

  • ILF Updates:

    • Peer Pay - Chile | GftW Grantee PeerPay - A new payment platform for people and companies - Web Monetization Community
    • Grantee Report - Qwyre.com - What we learned, and our ethical foundations and plans for future development [Grant Report #2] - Web Monetization Community
      • Gavin Chait of Qwyre speaking at the Community Call on Monday, April 25 at 10:00 am EST.
        • To register for this event go to: https://www.eventbrite.ca/e/310769438757
        • More details on the community call: Register now for this month's community events - Web Monetization Community
    • Mozfest tipping experiment got a good response. Content Platforms/ Creators received tippings
      • 300+ active tippers
      • Double the activations by mid-summer
      • Next couple of months continue to experiment
      • Curating gallery spaces for WM content was a success

  • Fynbos Update:

    • Beta users in the US this quarter
    • Hoping to have open up uses in EU and UK in the end of Q3
    • Licensing work ongoing
    • Working with Banks to sponsor us to
    • The product will leverage Rafiki, integration to Tech stack currently ongoing
    • Help the community get to the point where integrating Rafiki is well documented

  • Open Payments API v2 Updates

    • Got away from the Asynchronous nature of APIs
    • Simplified the Incoming payment flow - check received amount/ can’t see a pending state/ processing state/ completed state -
    • Removed quotes from payments, added them as a separate API feat: add quotes by wilsonianb · Pull Request #97 · interledger/open-payments · GitHub
    • You can follow along with the spec proposals on GitHub - Pull requests · interledger/open-payments · GitHub
      • Join the calls to discuss
    • https://docs.openpayments.guide/ - start getting feedback from people

  • https://mozfest.hyper.audio
